inspection.frontend_existing_surface: frontend/src/factura-operaciones.scss and existing app invoice/tax administration surfaces; exact component deltas belong to FRONTEND_UX, not PRE
current_state: Factura already snapshots issuer/customer/monetary information and links to Venta, but has no jurisdiction-specific electronic-fiscal authority state.
Impuesto is administrable and snapshots applied rates/amounts; it is generic configuration, not a universal fiscal-law engine.
SecuenciaDocumento is scoped by Empresa plus optional Sucursal plus TipoDocumento and explicitly states that it does not represent fiscal format or SAR/CAI range.
Empresa persists legal/commercial identity including RTN and address.
FacturasController is authenticated/RBAC-protected for private operations and exposes existing invoice read/payment/status/PDF/share operations.

target_scope.goal: Provide an extensible fiscal/electronic-invoicing model whose jurisdiction-specific requirements are selected/configured per tenant/company and never hardcoded as international universal rules.
in_scope_next: Jurisdiction-aware domain/contract boundary for fiscal profile, document authorization/status, immutable fiscal emission snapshot and provider/adaptor result.
Reuse Empresa/Sucursal tenant context, generic Impuesto snapshots and concurrency-safe SecuenciaDocumento without overloading them with jurisdiction-specific constants.
Explicit capability/configuration checks so fiscal emission fails closed when the selected jurisdiction/provider is not configured.
Idempotent emission/retry semantics and auditable lifecycle compatible with existing outbox/idempotency infrastructure from completed dependencies.
Provider/adaptor contracts that isolate legal/provider-specific validation, serialization, submission and status lookup from core Factura domain.
out_of_scope_pre: No production electronic-fiscal emission in N7.10.A.
No provider credentials, secrets, deploy or Production changes.
No large schema/API/frontend implementation in PRE; those belong to B-G.

risks: Mixing jurisdiction rules into core Factura/Impuesto would make one country's rules universal.
Reusing NumeroFactura as a fiscal authorization identifier could conflate commercial numbering with authority-issued identity.
Provider retry without durable idempotency could duplicate external emission.
Mutable issuer/customer/tax data after emission could invalidate the legal snapshot.
Tenant/sucursal scope mistakes could cross fiscal configuration or numbering boundaries.
acceptance_for_chain: B must introduce only strict domain/contracts and keep jurisdiction details behind explicit profiles/adapters.
C persists only confirmed fiscal state with tenant/sucursal scope, uniqueness/idempotency and migrations proven on MySQL when applicable.
D API/application must enforce RBAC/tenant context, fail-closed configuration and idempotent emission/status operations.
E surfaces status/configuration without exposing secrets and without fabricating authority acceptance.
F verifies RBAC, tenant isolation, logging redaction, replay/idempotency and provider/webhook security.
G runs directed plus regression CI including MySQL/migrations; H certifies only behavior actually implemented.
rollback_strategy: Each implementation microtask remains independently revertible. PRE itself changes only evidence. Any later fiscal provider/schema feature must preserve the pre-existing generic invoice path behind explicit configuration/capability boundaries so disabling/removing the fiscal adapter restores the existing non-electronic behavior without rewriting historical invoices.
test_strategy: Domain tests for jurisdiction selection, immutable snapshot and fail-closed invariants.
Persistence tests for tenant/sucursal isolation, uniqueness/idempotency and migration roundtrip on MySQL.
API tests for RBAC, tenant scope, invalid/unconfigured jurisdiction/provider, retry and status mapping.
Security tests for secret/PII redaction, webhook/provider authentication when introduced and replay resistance.
Regression gates for existing invoice/tax/sequence behavior and full applicable CI at TEST_CI.
